title: Generic camp events repeat conspicuously during extended resting
reproduction: Start a fresh campaign and repeatedly Camp through the campaign clock. Across 53 camps the current-main browser run showed Thin Rations 6 times and Night Steps 5 times, including Night Steps on consecutive camps around Days 8-9 and again on consecutive camps on Day 18.
player_impact_summary: The strongest companion scenes feel authored and specific, but recurring generic events make extended road life feel like a small random table and reduce the impact of otherwise memorable character moments.
notes: Existing Storyteller task LR-0007 owns conditional event integration and already consumes the completed LR-0046 authored event pack; no duplicate task created.
